## Summary

Describe the change and its user, contract, privacy, or operational impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Documentation and environment examples updated where needed

## Security and release boundary

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, tokens, signatures, private memos, or personal data are included
- [ ] Claim authorization, wallet proof, X identity, receipt verification, roles, fees, cancellation, and refunds remain correct or have regression tests
- [ ] Testnet, source-verification, audit, hosting, and production claims remain accurate
